question: How is the radiant figure associated with the serpent described?
premises: It is upon a shining body.
That body wears a white-colored garment.
inference: The shining, white-garmented figure is depicted above a snow-shaded serpent.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation among the descriptive elements is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: Upon a snow-shaded serpent is the shining body of one clothed in white.
